snippet.title: Omertà: Mafia Novel - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now to stay updated for launch!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3982430/Omert_Mafia_Novel?utm_source=youtube3

In post-war America, the mafia no longer hides in the shadows - it rules the streets, the banks, and the politicians. The families control the avenues, the banks serve their interests, and the politicians are their toys. Yet even among your own, there is Omertà - the code of silence that can never be broken.

You are Alessandro Verí, a man whose life now belongs entirely to the clan. To prove your loyalty, you are given a mission: infiltrate one of the most dangerous prisons in the country and establish a smuggling network from within. But behind bars, there are no simple rules - only endless intrigues and a brutal struggle for power.

Every day here is a conspiracy.
Every glance - a test.
Every word can save you... or bury you.

You decide whom to swear loyalty to, whom to betray, whom to break, and whom to spare. The fates of those around you are at stake. Their blood, their secrets, their lives - all rest in your hands.

In this story:
Darkness & Neon - 1950s New York, cigarette smoke, whispers behind closed doors, and the cold gleam of a straight razor.

Code of Honor - family demands loyalty... but never forgives mistakes.
Conspiracies & Betrayals - every deal is dangerous, and every broken promise carries a deadly price.

Fates Intertwined - every choice changes not only your path, but the lives... and deaths... of others.

The Price of Silence - in the shadow of Omertà, there are no “right” decisions. There is only survival.

Here, there are no winners.
Only those who learn to survive...
and those who disappear without a trace.

#VisualNovel #NoirGame #IndieGame #MafiaStory
